field.label: Name
field.help: A name for this profile. Profiles are referenced by their identity, so renaming one changes nothing else.

field.label: Byte rate
field.help: How fast the flow moves data (smoothed bytes per second, both directions).

field.label: Packet rate
field.help: How many packets per second the flow moves (smoothed).

field.label: Active states
field.help: How many PF states the flow has now.

field.label: New-state rate
field.help: How many new states the flow opens per second.

field.label: Flow volume
field.help: How many bytes the flow moved since it became active.

field.label: PF blocked activity
field.help: Blocked attempts by the remote in the firewall log (only rules with logging enabled).

field.label: Threat intelligence
field.help: The remote is on a threat list.

field.label: IDS evidence
field.help: Suricata alerts for the remote; high-severity alerts count double.

field.label: Asset importance: multipliers, not part of the 100
Default multiplier
field.help: The multiplier of local hosts no rule below matches, from 1 (the quality score as it is) to 100.

field.label: Rules
field.help: One rule per line: a network or host and its multiplier, for example "192.168.1.25 10" or "192.168.10.0/24 3"; a multiplier is from 1 (no boost) to 100. A flow takes the multiplier of its local host's longest matching rule; rules never multiply each other. Importance changes ranking only, never the security class of a flow.

field.label: Security visibility: minimum share of the ranked flows, not part of the 100
S3 minimum (%)
field.help: Places kept for flows with high-severity IDS alerts, as a percentage of the ranked flows (rounded up). A minimum, never a cap: unused places go to other flows.

field.label: S2 minimum (%)
field.help: Places kept for flows with other IDS alerts or heavy blocking, as a percentage of the ranked flows (rounded up). A minimum, never a cap: unused places go to other flows.

field.label: S1 minimum (%)
field.help: Places kept for flows with any other security evidence, as a percentage of the ranked flows (rounded up). A minimum, never a cap: unused places go to other flows.

field.label: Direction
field.help: Equal: inbound and outbound flows count the same.
